messages:
maria-support: Heads-up — StellarRetail (acct: STEL-204) reported invoice missing PO after a card decline. Invoice INV-2026-00321 for $12,400 shows no PO on the issued invoice. Customer insists the PO (PO-9812) must be on the reissued invoice and wants the previous charge credited. Can billing take this? cc @raj-billing @ellie-ops

raj-billing: @maria-support thanks. Quick Qs: was the payment ever captured or just auth failed? Any reseller/tax notes we need to preserve? :eyes:

maria-support: Payment state is `authorization_failed` per payments API. No capture. Customer emailed that their AP team needs the PO on the invoice PDF itself (not just memo). They also flagged VAT handling for EU subsidiary. Attached client note: "Please include PO-9812 and VAT ID EU1234567."

ellie-ops: Sounds straightforward. Steps I'd follow: 1) Create credit/void for the failed attempt (so invoice is clean), 2) Attach PO + VAT ID to invoice metadata, 3) Reissue invoice PDF, 4) Send new payment link. I can handle metadata + PDF if billing creates the credit.

raj-billing: Plan: I will create a credit note referencing INV-2026-00321 and then reissue a new invoice with PO-9812 + VAT ID. Two quick asks: a) confirm refund vs credit (since not captured, we issue a credit note), b) GL code for credit? Use `revenue-adjustments` for now and we'll reconcile.

maria-support: Confirmed with customer — credit note is fine (they only need a clean invoice with PO). GL `revenue-adjustments` okay. Customer prefers email to ap@stellarretail.com after reissue.

billing-bot: Credit created: CR-2026-0042 (auto) for INV-2026-00321 — status: pending_review. Link: https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2026-0042 :white_check_mark:

raj-billing: I reviewed CR-2026-0042, approved it, and reissued invoice as INV-2026-00321-R1 with PO-9812 and VAT ID EU1234567. PDF: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2026-00321-R1.pdf. I've set `external_notes` to "PO: PO-9812; VAT: EU1234567; original attempt failed auth". Sent email to ap@stellarretail.com with payment link. :thumbsup:

sam-se: Thx — I deployed a small change to invoice PDF template yesterday that ensures `external_notes` prints on the first page. Verified the new PDF includes PO and VAT.

maria-support: Awesome, customer confirmed receipt and says AP accepted the PO on the invoice. Closing ticket — thanks all. :tada:
